While at the [[Petranaki arena]], '''this reek''' was used as the means to execute [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were captured by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], this reek was selected along with an [[Unidentified acklay (Petranaki Arena)/Legends|acklay]] and a [[Unidentified nexu/Legends|nexu]] to be the animals used to execute the three. Because of it being deprived of its herbivorous diet, it was extremely aggressive. The three manage to escape from their chains and fight back against the creatures, Skywalker being able to [[Animal bond|tame]] the reek and use it to kill the Nexu and rescue both Amidala and Kenobi.<ref name="AOTC" />

When the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Geonosis strike team]] arrived and helped the three prisoners, the reek bucked its three riders off and went around the arena. During the fight, he charged at Mace Windu who cut one of his horns. When [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] landed in the arena to help fight, the reek ran over him, damaging his [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12]] [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]. When the reek turned around for another charge, Jango shot it with his [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistol]]. The reek died seconds later.<ref name="AOTC" />
